description: Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales (IDE), Uruguay publishes polygons of each urbanised area of Uruguay, defined as a set of at least 20 buildings where none lies more than 100 metres from its nearest neighbour, derived from the national photogrammetric flight of 2017 to 2018. Coverage: the whole of Uruguay; the portal record was last modified on 2026-08-26. Format and access: GeoJSON, downloadable without registration from the Uruguay national open data catalogue; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Licencia de DAG de Uruguay; cost: free. Caveats: the polygons are derived from a 2017-2018 flight and do not follow later growth; the GeoJSON was not opened, so the polygon count and attribute fields are unconfirmed. Simulation uses: a built-up area mask for exposure and population allocation in flood, coastal and heat models, and as a boundary layer for urban growth studies. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
